usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/videos/generations with JSON body {model:"bytedance/seedance-2.0", prompt} paid via x402 USDC on Base; then GET the returned poll_url (also x402-paid) to retrieve the video.
usage.outputShape: POST 202 -> body.id, body.status ("queued"), body.poll_url, body.price.amount, body.payment_status. Poll the poll_url; when body.status=="completed" the response carries the video URL (field not captured in QA, expected video url in the completed job body).
quirks: REAL PRICE IS ~$1.49 USDC per call, NOT $0.150 — the registry priceAmount/priceDisplay is stale by ~10x. POST body.price.amount reports the true charge (e.g. '1.488816').

Async job: POST returns status=queued with a relative poll_url. Result = GET that poll_url with a fresh x-payment header signed by the SAME wallet that submitted the POST (wallet-binding enforced, not signature byte-equality). The poll endpoint issues its own 402 challenge so x402 clients re-sign automatically.

MONEY TRAP: the poll response says 'No charge until status=completed', but settlement capture shows EVERY poll actually pays the full ~$1.49 even while status=in_progress. Do NOT poll repeatedly — each poll costs the full generation price. Wait the full generation time (60-180s) before polling, and poll as few times as possible.
poll_url is relative (/api/v1/...); prefix with https://blockrun.ai. The URL contains its own sig query param — use it verbatim.
Generation takes 60-180s; in QA it was still in_progress after ~90s, so the completed-state body and final video URL were not captured.
usage.guide: POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/videos/generations with JSON {"model":"bytedance/seedance-2.0","prompt":"<your prompt>"}, paying via x402 USDC on Base. Expect a 202 with a queued video.generation.job: keep body.id and body.poll_url. Budget ~$1.49 per generation — the $0.150 registry price is stale. Wait the full 60-180s, then GET https://blockrun.ai + body.poll_url (verbatim, including its sig param) with a fresh x402 payment signed by the same wallet; read the video URL from the completed job body. CRITICAL: each poll re-charges the full ~$1.49 despite the 'no charge until completed' note, so poll as rarely as possible (ideally once, after a long wait).
